outcome: Incidence of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP)
cohort: Pregnant women delivering at ≥24 weeks' gestation
finding: The incidence of HDP was relatively low but was associated with increased risks of stillbirth, low birth weight, preterm birth, and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Pregnancies complicated by hypertensive disorders were associated with a higher rate of Cesarean section deliveries.
